classification.difficultyReason: Infer missing dimensions and subtract rectangular or triangular areas from enclosing rectangles.

content.prompt: Find the area of each shaded region.

spec.description: Rectangular frame with four separate thickness arrows. Source blue shading is represented by house light blue because it identifies the requested region; ordinary outlines, dimensions and labels are black.
spec.mathematics: Outer rectangle 6 m by 5 m; opening inset 1 m from every edge.

answer.worked:
Subtract the opening from the outer rectangle.
$$\begin{align*}
\text{Inner length}&=6-1-1=4\text{ m}\\
\text{Inner height}&=5-1-1=3\text{ m}\\
\text{Shaded area}&=6\times5-4\times3\\
\text{Shaded area}&=30-12\\
\text{Shaded area}&=18\text{ m}^2
\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Shaded quadrilateral beneath a rising straight top edge. Retains the dashed enclosing corner, all four right-angle markers and separate vertical dimensions. House light blue identifies the requested region; house red distinguishes construction lines.
spec.mathematics: Horizontal width 8 m; left shaded height 4 m; additional construction height 2 m; right vertical height consequently 6 m.
spec.answerVisibility: Only source givens appear; the inferred 6 m height is not printed.

answer.worked:
Subtract the unshaded triangle from the enclosing rectangle.
$$\begin{align*}
\text{Rectangle height}&=4+2=6\text{ m}\\
\text{Rectangle area}&=8\times6=48\text{ m}^2\\
\text{Triangle area}&=\frac12\times8\times2=8\text{ m}^2\\
\text{Shaded area}&=48-8\\
\text{Shaded area}&=40\text{ m}^2
\end{align*}$$
